name: Keccak
description: Browser-based Keccak hash calculator supporting Keccak-224, Keccak-256, Keccak-384, and Keccak-512. All computation is local — no data is transmitted.
headline: Keccak-256 Hash Calculator
featureList: Text hashing, File hashing, Hex output, Base64 output, Binary output, Hash history, Random hash generation
